Rationale: The Candidate's sentence 'Which <object> does the <instructor> have ?' is not a valid SQUALL sentence. In SQUALL, a sentence starting with 'Which <object>' (the target NP) must be followed by a Verb Phrase (VP). A VP cannot take the form 'does the <instructor> have' (AUX_DO + NP + RELATION); that structure is part of an 'INVERTED_S' (a Yes/No question), which cannot be prefixed by a 'Which' clause. A grammatically correct SQUALL version would be 'the <instructor> has which <object> ?' or 'Which <object> is had by the <instructor> ?'.
